The Momnibus is about improving maternal health outcomes for all parents, and closing the maternal mortality and morbidity gap for Black moms.

Our Mamas can’t wait.

#PassTheMomnibus https://t.co/9LhNMM0qL3

Three years ago today, Kamala Harris made history when she joined President Biden’s presidential ticket … but earlier that year we made history together by introducing the Momnibus to address the Black maternal health crisis.
@AndrewCarolinas Yes. Social determinants of health are a large part of the legislative package.

Today is the 59th Anniversary of the Food Stamp Act of 1964, which authorized SNAP, our most successful anti-hunger program. 

We must #DefendSNAP to continue to improve the health and wellbeing of hungry American families while strengthening our farmers and our farms. https://t.co/FxIxvefTmr

On the 22nd anniversary of the 9/11 attacks, we stand together to honor those lost, their loved ones, the survivors, and the heroes who helped save lives that day. Our country owes a debt to them, and we should continue to care for their health and wellbeing.

#NeverForget https://t.co/yoPS5qPbR9

Congressional Republicans have doubled child poverty in only a year.

However, instead of addressing student nutrition, homelessness, or socioeconomic factors, the next House subcommittee meeting on public education is about finding Chinese communists in elementary schools.

That's why I was proud to introduce the Maternal and Child Health Stillbirth Prevention Act which would increase funding for evidence-based programs and research to help reduce instances of stillbirth.

Proud to be named #Champion4Children by @campaign4kids, but the work isn't over. Rising costs & threats to healthcare, education, & child nutrition mean we must keep fighting for every child. Join me in demanding Congress #InvestInKids & make their well-being a top priority. https://t.co/PWrghI4o6w

GREAT news for our schools, faculty & students. The Biden-Harris Administration continues delivering wins to North Carolina.

We love having a @WhiteHouse that understands the importance of BOTH mental health and gun safety in our schools.

Come back anytime, Madame @VP.

That’s why @repunderwood and I, along with the @BMHCaucus, introduced the Momnibus Act to fill the gap in existing legislation and comprehensively address the maternal health crisis in America. Congress must act to protect our mothers and their babies! #maternalhealthawarenessday

Women often bear the weight of caring for our households and those in them. It's up to us to be vigilant about our health, whether it's quitting smoking like I did more than 30 years ago, changing our diets, or reducing  stress in our lives.
That's why I'm wearing red today to raise awareness for heart health. https://t.co/ccR24H6siH

Tomorrow is the last day to sign up for the Affordable Connectivity Program. This program ensures that families can afford the broadband they need for work, school, healthcare and more by providing a discount of up to $30 per month toward internet service for eligible households. https://t.co/3hhS8jl709

Together, on #InternationalChildhoodCancerAwarenessDay, we must raise our voices and envision the day all children and adolescents with cancer benefit from the best possible treatment, care, and support regardless of where they come from.

No family facing a cancer diagnosis should ever have to choose between paying their medical bills, their mortgage, or putting food on their table. That’s why I remain committed to creating a healthcare system that works for all Americans.
